items.summary: StateM improves long-horizon agent execution to 95.3% on Terminal-Bench via harness scaling, achieving frontier performance at $15 compute cost.

items.summary: FreeToken: MoE serving system optimizing edge inference with bandwidth-adaptive execution. Treats personal machines as unified elastic platforms for frontier models.

items.summary: StartupBench: Market-validated workflow benchmark for general-purpose agents. Evaluates real-world productivity gains from agentic systems.

items.summary: Abra: Systematic scaling law study for text-to-image diffusion models across three orders of magnitude. Guides compute-optimal training of visual generation.

items.summary: Research analyzing when and why LLM agent skills succeed or fail. Diagnostic study of skill composition limitations in agent systems.

items.summary: Research on embodied navigation using VLMs with point-think-memorize-align framework. Addresses misalignment between VLM pre-training and action space design.

items.summary: Agentic ESOpt: RL fine-tuning method for long-horizon LLM agents with minimal GPU requirements. Addresses scalability of multi-turn agentic training.

items.summary: HarmProfile: Systematic characterization of harmful outputs in frontier LLMs. Provides dataset and analysis of model misbehavior for safety research.

items.summary: Holistic evaluation of memory substrates (storage formats) for long-horizon LLM agents. Provides guidance on memory architecture choices.

items.summary: HarnessRisk: Safety benchmark for agent harness lifecycle covering tools, state management, permissions. Evaluates operational safety of production agent systems.

items.summary: Security assessment of DeepSeek Harness against indirect prompt injection via 14.5k controlled test cases. Evaluates production safety of agent infrastructure.
